    {
      "fromKey": "n-1imw4n6",

      "evidenceGap": "The exact timing of signature relative to interruption remains unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1q47r99",
      "toKey": "n-x2152q",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The daily work briefing listed '1SC dryer work and RHOB service coordination' with no valve-by-valve content, suggesting incomplete procedural detail.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],

      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],

      "fromKey": "n-1g9ltls",
      "toKey": "n-x2152q",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "A command, a field-position observation and a proved internal valve condition are different records; the empty form field on the work package cover does not establish that an instruction was required or ignored.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["d838e866-dc34-4814-8dad-3b97d0353f05#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the form field had been filled, it might have indicated a specific instruction.",

    "summary": "The incident involved an instrument-air interruption during maintenance preparation. The evidence supports that the boundary was not released, the briefing lacked detail, and recent changes were not confirmed as seen by the crew. However, the origin of the pressure drop remains unknown.",
